## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

### Global Metadata
Modern C-pop dance-pop with Guofeng (traditional Chinese style) flavoring, period romance drama OST, around 115 BPM, G major. The track opens with a bright, airy atmosphere — a plucked guzheng-like motif over sparkling synths — then moves immediately into warm, joyful momentum. The verses are light and playful, the choruses bloom into wide, sunny, sing-along euphoria, and the bridge softens into a tender, sincere declaration before the final chorus delivers the brightest, most celebratory release of the song. The mood is consistently positive, sweet and hopeful — no melancholy, no heartbreak. Application imagery: lantern festival long streets in a period romance, two lovers walking under paper umbrellas, peach-blossom courtyards, sweet drama highlight reels. The production is polished, modern and radio-ready: a warm punchy low end, crisp bright transients, sparkling high-frequency shimmer, and a forward, intimate vocal sitting clearly on top of the groove.

### Vocal Details
A single young female vocalist in her early twenties with a bright, sweet, clean timbre — light and playful in the verses, open and glowing in the choruses. Her delivery is sincere and smiling, as if singing directly to someone she loves: precise, crisp diction with every syllable clearly articulated, no mumbled or blurred phrasing, light natural vibrato only on sustained chorus notes. Phrasing is rhythmic and bouncy in the verses, legato and flowing in the choruses. Subtle self-layered harmonies thicken the final chorus, mixed below the lead. Light plate reverb and a very short delay keep the voice present and clean — no heavy effects, no autotune coloration. The closing "la la la" is sung softly and happily.

### Arrangement
[Intro] A bright, plucked guzheng-like synth lead plays the main melodic hook over airy pads and a soft percussion tick; the motif is immediately memorable.
[Verse 1] The vocal enters over the guzheng-style hook, a clean plucked electric guitar, warm synth stabs and a light bouncy beat — kick, snap and soft shaker — keeping the texture playful and intimate.
[Pre-Chorus] Rising synth pads and a four-on-the-floor kick build anticipation, with a reverse swell lifting into the chorus.
[Chorus] The arrangement opens bright and wide: driving pop drums, a melodic bouncing bass, layered sparkling synths, strummed acoustic guitar and the guzheng-style hook weaving between vocal lines — pure sunny sing-along energy.
[Verse 2] The groove continues but thins slightly, adding a delicate plucked pipa-like countermelody and finger-snap percussion for charm.
[Pre-Chorus / Chorus] Same build and release with richer harmony layers.
[Bridge] Everything drops to warm piano, soft pads and the voice for a tender, near-whispered declaration, then a rising drum fill rebuilds into the final chorus.
[Final Chorus] Maximum brightness: harmonies beneath the lead, the guzheng-style hook soaring above the strings-like synth bed, then the instruments peel away on "有你在 人间就值得", leaving voice and piano.
[Outro] The opening guzheng-style hook returns with the soft "la la la", fading on a final sparkling chime. Instrument lifecycle: the guzheng-like synth hook is the identity thread from first second to last, modern pop drums and bass drive from the first chorus onward, piano anchors the bridge, pads and sparkles color every build.
